notes.title: Gauntlet Difficulty Patch
notes.notes:
Gauntlet Changes:
[list]
[*] Significantly increased the difficulty of Gauntlet opponents. The hardest opponents from before should be among the easiest now.
[/list]

Delve Changes:
[list]
[*] Delves now begin with 3 additional cards.
[*] At the start of the delve, there is a screen that shows you your starting cards so you don't need to go to the deckbuilder before making your shop decision.
[/list]

notes.title: The Gauntlet Patch
notes.notes:
New Game Mode: Gauntlet
Normal: Defeat 5 enemies in a row to progress to the next difficulty and earn rewards
Auto: The 5 games will be played automatically with your selected deck, create decks even a bot can win with to progress.

2 new leaders, bosses unlocked via winning in auto gauntlet mode. 

Various new abilities.
Reworked a lot of the card images to be more thematic.

Gameplay Changes:
You can now click on non-exhausted units to exhaust them manually if you don't want them to attack.
Added the option to slow the game speed down up to half

Bug fixes:
Fixed a rare issue where enemies would get stuck and hang the gamestate.
Fixed pack opening not always rendering the most recently opened cards on top
Various fixes to the opponent AI logic

notes.title: Clarity Patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Hold shift and press arrow keys to move through the game log. Release shift to go back to the current game. 
[*] Bolded some key text on effects.
[/list]

notes.title: Minor Feature Patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Added autoplay functionality: Hold control during your turn for the game to automatically play cards for you. Uses the same AI as opponents.
[*] Improved the opponent AI, should be doing fewer things that look really dumb now.
[*] Some UI improvements.
[/list]

Now with steam's position on AI art in games is more stable, I might work on this more if there's still any interest.

notes.title: Post-Release Patch #1
notes.notes:
Gameplay Changes:
Added the ability for most effects that target to be cancelled rather than needing to select a target. 

Bug Fixes:
Fixed a couple of issues where effect descriptions were incorrect.
Fixed issue where the deep delve achievement would only unlock if you ended your run immediately after beating the 3rd boss.

notes.title: Patch Notes 6/3

Some New Relics Added
New Effects added

Fixed rare issue where AI would get stuck and the game wouldn't continue related to some relics.

Changed the card template, added a bit of color and made the static elements on the cards a bit smaller.
Added a 3rd row of cards to the deckbuilder screen.

notes.title: 5/2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Balance Changes:
Xaathu to 4 power from 2. Xaathu had a low win rate in Delves where assembling synergies is harder, while he was still useful as a boss rush leader, this change doesn't do much to make those constructed decks stronger.

Some minor UI tweaks that have been building up for awhile, waiting for a client compile.

notes.title: Patch Notes 1/30

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where some constant effects were being generated with variable magnitudes
[*] Maybe fixed issue where survives damage effects were sometimes triggering even to lethal damage? Really not sure the cause of this one, but I added another sanity check.
[*] Transmute the top card of deck, do X based on card's cost was incorrectly classified as a blue effect
[*] Fixed issue where multipart effects didn't properly check for targets
[*] Fixed an issue where "Search your deck for a unit that costs x or less" only let you get cards with the exact cost
[*] Fixed an issue that led to some cards being treated as destroyed twice.
[/list]


[h2]Gameplay Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The leader of the enemy of combat floors are indicated on the node.
[*] Life no longer carries over between fights, instead the amount of money you get for beating a fight is dependent on how much life you had remaining. 
[*] --Made aggro decks more punishing to play against, even when the aggro decks were weak and posed no threat of ending the run. I think it's important to have an incentive to keep your life total high, but the previous system was a bit too unfairly punishing.
[/list]

Been moving a bit fast on the features, so going to spend the rest of this week mostly focusing on bugfixes and balancing so get those bug reports in on Discord.

notes.title: patch 1/20 pt. 2
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:
Regular ai battles should properly give income, and scale a bit past level 10. 
Fixed critical bug that would cause the game to fail to load if you deleted an active deck. 

Gameplay Changes:
Effects that discard multiple cards, or sacrifice multiple creatures will resolve their discard or sacrifice as much as possible, then not do the second part of their effect if there aren't enough cards to discard/sacrifice, instead of just not doing anything.
After beating a floor boss you are now shown 2 random upgrades to your leader from the set: New Ability, +Power, +Health, -Cost
Leader cost only increases if it would go to the grave, or the deck. If it is returned to your hand, or transmuted it just returns to the leader zone without having it's cost increased.

Features:
Added new boss
